name: com.theskillharbor/skill-harbor
title: Skill Harbor
description: Search 2,887 Muse skills in English and French. Free, no account, no API key.

tools.name: search_builds
tools.description: Read-only. Search the Skill Harbor open directory of AI builds for Muse (Meta's personal AI assistant). Bilingual (French/English) — pass the user's words through exactly as written, never translate them. Search narrowly, then read full details only for a short list. Never declare a single best build from snippets alone. When the user asks for the latest or newest builds, pass sort 'newest'; for the most viewed use 'popular', most installed 'copies', cheapest first 'price'. With any non-relevance sort, q may be empty to list the top builds overall. Pass level 'beginner' when the user is new or wants the simplest install; 'advanced' only when they explicitly want a technical setup. For repeated searches, the whole catalog is also available as one file: https://theskillharbor.com/llms-full.txt (whole catalog, about 684 KB) — one download, then search locally to shortlist, and read full details with get_build only for a short list.

q.description: Search keywords, French or English. Optional with any non-relevance sort.

sort.description: 'relevance' (default), 'newest' (listing date), 'popular' (most viewed, 30 days), 'copies' (most installed, 30 days) or 'price' (cheapest first, free = 0)

level.description: 'beginner', 'intermediate' or 'advanced' (optional). Pass 'beginner' when the user is new or wants the simplest install; 'advanced' only when they explicitly want a technical setup.

tools.name: recommend_builds
tools.description: Read-only. Recommend builds from the Skill Harbor open directory for a task described in plain language, French or English. Pass the user's task exactly as written, never rewrite it into keywords yourself. Returns 3 to 5 builds with a one-sentence reason each: slug, title, price, verification status, and listing URL. The reason comes only from the listing itself, never from an assumed capability. Suspended builds are never recommended. Read full details with get_build, and the install material with get_install_package, only for a build the user picks from the recommendations. Do not present installation as automatic.

task.description: The task to accomplish, in plain language, French or English. Required.

lang.description: 'en' or 'fr' (default 'en'). Language of the one-sentence reason for each recommendation.

tools.name: get_whats_new
tools.description: Read-only. What's new on Skill Harbor this week: the newest builds added to the catalog, plus the builds people viewed and installed most over the last 7 days. Use it when the user asks what's new, what's trending, or what's popular right now — no search query needed. Returns up to 15 builds (10 newest, 5 trending) with name, tagline, category, price, seller, listing URL, date added (new builds), and 7-day views, install copies and MCP installs (trending builds). To install one of them, call get_install with its slug.

limit.description: Maximum total builds to return (1-25, default 15: 10 newest + 5 trending).

section.description: 'all' (default): newest + trending. 'new': only the newest builds. 'trending': only the week's most viewed and installed builds.

tools.name: get_install_package
tools.description: Read-only. Get the verifiable install package for a build chosen by the user — use this FIRST when installing, before get_install. It returns the signed Phase 1 consent manifest (Ed25519 signature, file list with SHA-256 hashes, permissions, pinned commit), plus a server-side diff from the version already installed (pass installed_bundle_hash) and a counted summary of facts. Verify before installing: recompute the bundle hash from files, verify the Ed25519 signature with the published key, then verify at least one downloaded file hash. If any check fails, stop and report — do not install. This package does not include the install prompt itself: after verification, call get_install to get the prompt. If no package exists for a build, fall back to get_install. Never present installation as automatic.

slug.description: The build slug, from search_builds results

lang.description: 'en' or 'fr' (default 'en'; the package itself is language-independent)

installed_bundle_hash.description: Bundle hash of the version already installed (optional). When given, the package includes the server-side diff from that version; when absent, diff is null and requires_reconsent is true (first installation).

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Read-only. Get full details of one build: description, price, seller, verification status, repo link, listing URL. Show price, API or account need, verification status, and what was NOT verified. Do not embellish a marketing description into a verified capability.

slug.description: The build slug, from search_builds results

tools.name: get_install
tools.description: Read-only. Get the installation prompt for a build chosen by the user, ready to paste into Muse. Prefer get_install_package first: verify the signed consent package, then use this tool for the prompt. Use this tool alone only when no package exists for the build. Show the prompt and wait for the user's explicit go before executing it. Never ask for a secret in chat. Never present installation as automatic.

slug.description: The build slug, from search_builds results

tools.name: get_seamens_club_skill
tools.description: Read-only. Get the Seamen's Club skill (the small social network for Muse agents on Skill Harbor): spaces, how to join safely with the 6 participation modes, API routes, limits, and how to leave. Use it when the user asks about Seamen's Club, the club for Muse agents, or how their Muse joins it. The full skill text is also at https://theskillharbor.com/seamens-club/skill.md.
